title: Foundry Workstream State
description: Operational continuation index for one workstream. Not Source Authority; Git/test/evidence reality wins on conflict. Schema 2.0 identity: audit_base_sha/tree is the immutable source lock; validated_head (nullable) is the newest commit with actual validation evidence; state_written_against_head is descriptive only; current_runtime_head is never stored (derive live via state.py --workdir).

state_written_against_head.description: Descriptive HEAD at document production time. Never a validation claim.

validated_head.description: Newest commit with actual validation evidence; null means none beyond the audit base.

validated_tree.description: Exact Git tree of validated_head. Required for the cross-executor review gate; null is honest for legacy/in-progress states.

materiality.description: Declared change-set materiality. MATERIAL (fail-safe default when policy-enabled) requires a fresh-context read-only Space Bunny PASS on validated_head/validated_tree before PR_READY/COMPLETE. A NON_MATERIAL claim is verified against the Git change set and fails closed if it hides material paths. Absent/null preserves historical state compatibility.

cross_executor_review.description: Policy-enabled cross-executor review mirror. Presence opts the workstream into the fail-closed review policy; absence keeps historical states parseable.

remote_checkpoint.description: Verified remote milestone checkpoint. A COMPLETE/PR_READY claim fails closed until live remote HEAD equals the recorded checkpoint (or a generated-state-only closeout descendant).

technical_decision_authority.description: Default AUTONOMOUS_WITHIN_CONTRACT; technical decisions are owned in-scope.

current_reasoning_tier.description: Project task-complexity / historical execution metadata. Provider-native effort is recorded separately in native_variant; active profiles pin each model to its highest project-authorized native effort.

next_action.description: Short operational pointer; exact_next_action remains binding.

execution_profile.description: Explicit currently authorized Foundry executor profile for the run. Null preserves historical state compatibility; historical executor names remain free-form provenance only in executor_model/hand-off evidence, not selectable profiles.

logical_executor_profile.description: Logical executor profile actually resolved for the run (same two-profile vocabulary as execution_profile).

resolved_provider.description: Provider of the exact resolved runtime model id (provenance; opencode-go under current policy).

resolved_model_id.description: Exact provider/model runtime identity selected for the run, e.g. opencode-go/space-bunny or the admitted legacy alias.

model_alias_class.description: Whether the resolved runtime id is the canonical model or the admitted legacy alias for the same logical profile.

executor_model.description: Exact provider/model identity used by the run; informational provenance, never Rules or qualification authority.

native_variant.description: Provider-native reasoning variant pinned by the currently authorized profiles. Both active OpenCode profiles run at native max; null is retained for legacy/unverified provenance only.

variant_resolution.description: How the native variant was resolved/pinned, matching launcher telemetry when present.

executor_handoff_from.description: Previous explicit execution profile when a workstream is resumed cross-model.

executor_handoff_reason.description: Evidence-based reason for an explicit executor handoff; never an automatic quota fallback.
